landing.title: Plan, configure, and package your next Claude Code project
landing.subtitle: A deterministic-first workspace for choosing stacks, agents, and skills, with optional AI assistance.

step1.title: Describe the project
step1.body: Capture the idea, the problem, and the proposed solution in plain language.

step2.title: Configure requirements
step2.body: Walk through the adaptive wizard to set domains, platforms, and requirements.

step3.title: Review recommendations
step3.body: Accept deterministic catalog recommendations, or bring in optional AI analysis.

step4.title: Generate the package
step4.body: Export a ready-to-use Claude Code package as a ZIP, manifest, or Markdown bundle.

localFirst.title: Local-first persistence
localFirst.body: Projects are saved to your browser's local storage — nothing leaves your machine by default.

deterministic.title: Deterministic recommendations
deterministic.body: A rule-based engine suggests stacks, agents, and skills without relying on AI.

catalog.title: Catalog and comparison
catalog.body: Browse, filter, and compare curated catalog items across every project kind.

optionalAI.title: Optional AI analysis
optionalAI.body: Ask for AI-assisted analysis only when you choose to, with explicit consent.

autosave.help: Applies to a project's details, requirements, and configuration while you're editing it.

ai.heading: AI assistance
ai.help: Enabling this only stores your preference and consent — it does not send any request by itself. Once enabled, you can start an AI analysis from a project's "AI analysis" page, where you'll see a fresh, explicit notice and send action before anything is transmitted.
ai.consentNotice: Enabling this lets you start an AI analysis from a project's AI analysis page, where a structured project brief is sent — only after a fresh, explicit send action there — to a server-side function that forwards it to the Claude API. No project data is sent automatically, and AI suggestions are always reviewed proposals you accept or reject, never automatic changes. Checking the box below is your consent to this behavior; you can withdraw it at any time by unchecking it.

export.label: Export local data
export.description: Download a JSON snapshot of everything DevFlow has stored on this device.

reset.description: Restore every setting above to its default value.
reset.confirmBody: This restores theme, language, defaults, and AI/local-data preferences to their defaults. You can undo this immediately after.

clear.label: Clear all local DevFlow data
clear.description: Erase everything DevFlow has stored on this device (this browser only). Nothing outside DevFlow's storage is touched.
clear.confirmBody: This permanently erases all DevFlow data stored in this browser. A backup file downloads automatically first so you can keep a copy.
clear.exportedNotice: A backup was downloaded before clearing.
